Discussion only · nothing is being built from this page

Ejam kopā: the new look

Round nine. The page is rebuilt around what you have agreed. It opens with the agreed rules, one line per element, then follows the way a person meets the site: the identity, the header and navigation, discovery, search, a group, an event, your own area, pop-ups, admin. Each element is drawn in full in one place; everywhere else it appears exactly the same, or the text points to it. Your answers of 12 October are applied everywhere: one "Sazināties" button, one filter row with the Grupas / Pasākumi switch at its right end, two-line group rows on phones, one place list with "Visur", a shorter profile menu and one phone header.

New in 9.2: your answers of 13 October (the redesign ships in parts; the language switch stays in the header; screens not drawn follow the rules; the event's place, faces, withdrawing a request, no "Mani pasākumi", social links), four screens drawn from the rules (the event page, Biedri, a group's Jaunumi, Mans profils), questions 4 and 8 redone as pictures, and near the end, everything from comparing this page with the live site. 9.3 (after a review): Still open is down to 18 real questions; what the Handbook or this page already decides is answered in the comparison instead. 9.4: your notes of 13 October: the + leaves the header (the bottom bar on phones, the profile menu on desktop); the search bar is a plain field that opens the search at once, with the place and the categories as chips inside it; the overlaps in the filter row are fixed in its one template; the sub-category only once a category is chosen; the date choices on one line; no arrows on the day strip; "Rādīt nākamo nedēļu" as a text link; "Citur". 9.5 (after a review): on phones the Grupas | Pasākumi switch has a line of its own and the filter buttons wrap below it, so nothing is cut or faded any more.

New in 9.6: your decisions of 13 October on the filter. One line: "Kur", "Tēma", on Pasākumi the date choices (no "Rīt"), the switch; each button shows its choice and clears with a small ×, so the separate chosen line is gone. Under it, once a Tēma is chosen, the "Veids" chips on one line with "+3" for the rest. Also: the day strip's month between ‹ and ›; a toast after "Sazināties"; "Atbildēt" on a join request; event rows with their short description again, the same row on the group page; and two drawings for "Rādīt visus rezultātus" (Still open, 1).

New in 9.7: your notes and decisions of 13 October, afternoon. Approved and recorded as such in the Agreed rules: the filter line, "+3" opening the Veids list (so no separate "Veids" button and no limit of eight), the search's look and its theme chips, and "Pieteikums nosūtīts" with "Atvērt sarunu" after asking to join. Pasākumi opens on "Šonedēļ"; "Šodien" looks chosen only once tapped. Weeks start on Monday and weekends are tinted in every day strip and calendar (the page's "today" is now Monday 12 October, so the sample dates are real). The calendar is a month only. Your question on choosing a theme in the search is answered under Search.

New in 9.8, the design freeze: your notes of 13 October, evening. Approved: one theme at a time in the search (AP-06) and "Rādīt visus rezultātus" as discovery with the search word as a chip (AP-07; the results page is dropped). Agreed: every text field shows its limit as a counter (AR-71); a group's image fills its banner, also on the event page (AR-70); "Sazināties" with the chat icon on join requests; "Eju" lines up with the time. Every rule and approval now has a stable id for the build plan, and the parts R1–R12 ship one by one without a feature switch.

Agreed rules

One line per element: the rule as it stands now, its status, and the section where it is drawn in full. If a drawing anywhere on the page disagrees with a line here, the line wins and the drawing is a mistake. Each line has a stable id (AR-01 …) and each of your approvals inside a line its own (AP-01 …): the build plan names them, and they are never renumbered.

Still open Agreed 13 Oct

Only real questions. On 13 October you agreed to the default of every one (build plan OD-01…OD-27); they are kept here with their numbers. Question 1 was settled on 13 October (A); its number stays so the others keep theirs. Questions 2–7 are from round nine (7 now also covers reporting an event); 8–18 came from comparing this page with the live site (Compared with the live app). Your answers of 13 October are in the Agreed rules.

  1. "Rādīt visus rezultātus" Settled 13 Oct: A

    You approved A, discovery filtered with the search word as a chip (AP-07); B, a results page, was declined. The number stays so the other questions keep theirs. Search → "Rādīt visus rezultātus".

  2. The bottom bar: where "Grupas" and "Es" lead, and which tab a group page marks Settled 13 Oct, build plan OD-02

    Agreed: "Grupas" opens Manas grupas, "Es" opens Mans profils; on a group page the tab you came from stays marked (Atklāt from discovery, Grupas from Manas grupas), as phone apps do.

  3. Where does Iestatījumi live? Settled 13 Oct, build plan OD-03

    The profile menu links to it, and light/dark is there. Agreed: the fifth page of your own area, last in its menu, like a group's Iestatījumi.

  4. The end of the group list Settled 13 Oct, build plan OD-13

    Events end with "Rādīt nākamo nedēļu"; groups have no rule. Agreed: 24 cards, then "Rādīt vēl", no endless scrolling (Handbook: calm, not sticky).

  5. The place for someone we don't know Settled 13 Oct, build plan OD-14

    Signed out, we know nothing. Agreed: start on "Visur" and ask "Kur tu esi?" once, above the results; keep the answer on the device; never guess from the internet address. Signed in: the profile city.

  6. When is a notification read? Settled 13 Oct, build plan OD-22

    You said you would decide later. Agreed: when you tap it, as today.

  7. Reporting people and events Settled 13 Oct, build plan OD-11

    Today only groups can be reported. Agreed: later, both together, as a second tab in Moderācija → Sūdzības; until then "Ziņot par grupu" in the group's "…" menu.

  8. Events you can't simply join: how do they look? Settled 13 Oct, build plan OD-18

    Agreed: one quiet word on the row ("Pieteikšanās" or "Pilns"), a button that names the step, and the outlined "Gaida" tag after you ask. Some events need the organiser's approval, some are full and have a waiting list. Pictures: An event → Events you can't simply join.

  9. Waiting join requests for the group team Settled 13 Oct, build plan OD-21

    Agreed: no separate section; "2 pieteikumi" on that group's row in Tavas grupas, and a tap opens Biedri → Pieteikumi. Today Manas grupas starts with a "Jārīkojas" list: the groups you help run where someone waits for an answer. Pictures: Your own area → Waiting join requests.

  10. Where do you change your profile? Settled 13 Oct, build plan OD-26

    Today "Labot profilu" is a page of its own; Mans profils is new. Changed 15 Oct: "Labot profilu" on Mans profils opens a page of its own (name, picture, about you, places); the three privacy switches move to Iestatījumi, which also keeps Izskats (the first text below is the 13 Oct version, replaced). Agreed 13 Oct: "Labot profilu" opens the form in place (name, picture, about you, places, the three privacy switches); Iestatījumi keeps Izskats, and later your account.

  11. Private groups Settled 13 Oct, build plan OD-07

    Today a group can be private (the create form says "Privāta", settings say "Tikai biedriem"): it is left out of discovery and search, and people join by invitation or approval. The page never shows one. Agreed: keep that, with one word everywhere, "Tikai biedriem"; someone with the link sees Informācija and "Sazināties" like any visitor, and the quiet line under the name ends with "Tikai biedriem".

  12. The full word behind "Mod" Settled 13 Oct, build plan OD-01

    Today the role reads "Grupas moderators". Agreed: the tag stays "Mod"; lists and menus say "Moderators"; "grupas komanda" means the owner and the moderators together, as in the Handbook.

  13. Members-only events, seen by members Settled 13 Oct, build plan OD-19

    Visitors don't see them (agreed). Agreed: members see them like any event; "Tikai biedriem" is a quiet line in the panel and on the event page, not on the row. Someone who follows a link without being a member gets one sentence and "Sazināties".

  14. How a member writes to the group's team Settled 13 Oct, build plan OD-10

    Today from the "all members" pop-up on Informācija, which goes. Agreed: "Rakstīt komandai" in the group's "…" menu (drawn in A group); it opens the same conversation as "Sazināties".

  15. Asking "are you sure?" for steps that can be undone Settled 13 Oct, build plan OD-06

    Deleting for good already has its rule (the Handbook: our own dialog in the middle, naming the thing; never the browser's box). Open are the smaller steps that can be undone, which today use the browser's box or a dialog. Agreed: a small pop-over at the button for leaving a group and removing a member.

  16. Deleting your account Settled 13 Oct, build plan OD-27

    It doesn't exist today, and the page doesn't mention it. Agreed: "Dzēst kontu" at the end of Iestatījumi, with a dialog; built before real people use the site.

  17. "Ko meklējam?" in one language or two Settled 13 Oct, build plan OD-12

    Agreed: one short text, as the team writes it, not one per language (a group's longer texts keep their LV | EN versions, as today).

    The event page, Biedri, a group's Jaunumi and Mans profils were drawn on 13 October from the rules (first marked Proposal). Agreed: build them as drawn; small details are reviewed on the test site.

The navigation rule Agreed

  1. Two levels: an area's pages (a group's pages, your own area's pages, admin's sections) and a page's parts (Par mums · Kā notiek pirmā tikšanās · Praktiski; Gaidāmie · Pagājušie; admin's pages). A page with parts of its own in admin (Dizains, Rokasgrāmata) opens them indented in the same list, never as a third menu.
  2. One level runs across, the other down. Never two rows across, stacked, and never two lists down, side by side.
  3. Groups and your own area: pages down the left, parts across as tabs. Admin: five sections across the top (sticky), their pages down the left.
  4. Phones: the pages go into a drawer from the left, opened by ☰ in the bar; the parts stay as tabs. Admin's many pages sit in the same drawer, under their section.
  5. No repeated labels: the chosen item already says where you are. On phones, where the menu is in the drawer, the page's name stands over its tabs.

Drawn in full: a group in A group, your own area in Your own area, admin in Admin.

On top, the month in the middle with ‹ and › at the two ends: they move the shown week back and forth (your note of 13 October; the "Šodien" link there is gone, because "Šodien" on the filter line already brings you back). Your question: "How would the categories be selected?" (on drawing 1, 13 October). You approved the look of 1 and the chips of 2; this is how one gets from 1 to 2.

  1. The chips come from the word. While you type, the themes whose name or Veidi match the word ("sp": Spēles, Sports un fitness) appear after the Kur button, quiet (not chosen). Nothing is chosen for you.
  2. A tap or click chooses one. The chip turns tinted with a × (drawing 2), the results narrow to that theme at once, and the field keeps what you typed, so you can go on typing ("vak"). You stay in the search; nothing opens.
  3. × or a second tap clears it, and the results widen again. Clearing the word never clears the place.

Approved 13 Oct One theme at a time, like the Tēma button on the filter line: once one is chosen, the other theme chips step aside (as in drawing 2) and come back with ×. "Rādīt visus rezultātus" takes the chosen theme along as the Tēma on discovery. You agreed on 13 October (AP-06).

One button: "Sazināties" Agreed

Your decision of 12 October: wherever a group can be reached (the opened card, the group header, the phone group bar), there is one button, "Sazināties". Its form has a switch, "Vēlos pievienoties grupai". While the group takes new members the switch is on, so the same short message also asks to join, and the form's title says so ("Pieteikties grupā …"); switched off, it is only a message ("Sazināties ar grupu …"). When the group takes no new members, the switch isn't there. There is no separate join button.

The live site today already has this form, with the switch, the changing title and the same texts. Three things differ and change with the redesign: the group header's button still reads "Pieteikties" while a group takes members (it will always read "Sazināties"); after asking, it shows "Pieprasīts" with a × to cancel (it will show "Pieteikums nosūtīts" and "Atvērt sarunu", as the Handbook says); and the send button reads "Sūtīt pieprasījumu" or "Sūtīt ziņu" (it will read "Nosūtīt": buttons name the result). After sending (your note of 13 October) the form simply closes and a short toast says "Ziņa nosūtīta": nobody answers that fast, so there is no second dialog and no "Atvērt sarunu" link; the answer arrives in Ziņas, and the bell says so.

Line one: time, category dot, name, city. The city is left out when one city is chosen. Line two, smaller: the group (a link to it), the category and the sub-category; left out on the group's own pages, where every event is that group's. The last line is the short description, back as you liked it in round four (your note of 13 October): the first words of the event's text, muted, one line, cut with "…". It answers "what is it?" before anyone clicks. It is part of the one row, so every list on this page has it. "Eju" sits under the time, so names stay in line, and left-aligned with it: the tag's tick starts exactly where the time's first digit does (your notes of 13 October; before, the tag's own padding pushed it 8 px to the right). Day headings carry the date, so it isn't repeated on every row. On wide screens the rows run in two columns, read down and then across; a list covers a week, then "Rādīt nākamo nedēļu".

Dizains has three parts. Krāsas: the site colour (Sūna to start) and the neutral background, lines and quiet text that go with it, light and dark; more themes can be added here later. Kategoriju krāsas: one row per category, its light and dark tone, and "AA ✓" or a short warning when a tone fails. Fonti: Literata and Commissioner, each with a Latvian sample, chosen from a short checked list so every option has all the Latvian letters. You preview a change yourself first, then publish it for everyone.

Why turned round. A group has four or five pages and few parts, so its pages fit a short list down the left. Salīdzinājums ar dzīvo lapu · Compared with the live app

On 13 October every screen of the live site was compared with this page, by reading the code on main. Below is everything that came out of it, not a summary: each live screen and where it is on this page; what the live site does that this page didn't mention, and what happens to it; where the two disagree, and whether that is an intended change, a mistake on this page, or still unclear; and what needs new data. Unclear points became questions in Still open (8–18), each answered on 13 October by agreeing to its default. File names are in small print, for the builders.

Your answers of 13 October

1 · One release? No: the redesign ships in logical parts, one by one (the build order below). Agreed rules → Identity
2 · Language and footer. The language switch is important: it stays visible in the header on every page, "LV ▾", built for more languages. A slim footer on discovery and reading pages. Header and navigation
3 · Screens not drawn. They follow the decisions on this page. The four most important are now drawn: the event page, Biedri, a group's Jaunumi, Mans profils (agreed 13 Oct). Agreed rules
4 · Events that need approval or are full. Redone as pictures: An event → Events you can't simply join (Still open, 8).
5 · The event's place. A required city from the list, filled in with the group's city, plus a free address; "Tiešsaistē" for online events, shown under "Visur". An event
6 · Faces of who is going. Only for signed-in viewers; visitors see "12 iet". An event
7 · Withdrawing a request. "Atsaukt pieteikumu" in the group's "…" menu and on the Tavi pieteikumi row. A group, Your own area
8 · The team's "Jārīkojas". Redone as pictures: Your own area → Waiting join requests (Still open, 9).
9 · "Mani pasākumi" on a group. It goes. A group
10 · Social links and member faces. Links as quiet text at the end of Informācija; faces only on Biedri. A group

Every live screen (61)

61 screens and pop-ups: 22 drawn, 10 partly drawn, 8 only named in a menu, 16 not drawn, 5 new screens with no live counterpart. 12 rows changed in 9.2 (marked "· 9.2"). At the comparison (9.1) the numbers were 13 drawn, 12 partly, 12 named only, 19 not covered. A screen that isn't drawn follows the rules on this page (your answer of 13 October).

Build order: twelve parts, each released on its own Agreed 13 Oct

Your answer of 13 October: not one big release. Each part is built, reviewed and released before the next; the site works after every one. Identity comes first, because every later part is drawn in it. No feature switch (your decision at the design freeze, 9.8): a part is not hidden behind a switch while it is built; it goes live for everyone when it is released, and the build plan names the rules each part carries by their ids (AR-…, AP-…, Agreed rules).

  1. R1 · Identity

    The fonts, Sūna and its neutrals, the fifteen category tones (light and dark), shapes and words; Admin → Dizains with Krāsas, Kategoriju krāsas, Fonti, preview and publish (the deferred Session 15); the Handbook's Design chapter rewritten to the agreed rules. Released: today's screens in the new look, after an independent review. MigrationMaybe one (D3)

  2. R2 · Header, menus, footer

    The header with the language switch "LV ▾" and room for search, the profile and shield menus, the bottom bar with its + (Atklāt, Grupas, +, Ziņas, Es), "Izveidot grupu" in the profile menu, the slim footer, your own area's frame with Iestatījumi (Izskats, Kā ierīcē), the short messages and the grey loading shapes (the Handbook's Behaviour rules). Plan item 3.4.

  3. R3 · A group's frame

    The lower header, pages down the left (☰ on phones), tabs, one "Sazināties", the waiting state, the new words (C3–C5, C8), the "…" menu with your role, "Atsaukt pieteikumu", reporting, leaving, sharing. Plan items 2.22 and 3.2.

  4. R4 · Discovery data

    "Ko meklējam?" and the event's place (with the form fields), several cities, counts, dates, sub-categories for events, each group's next meeting (D1, D2, D7–D11). Released: the new fields in the forms; the lists keep working as today. An independent review before release: it changes the database. Migrationadd_group_looking_for, add_event_city

  5. R5 · Discovery

    The filter line (Kur, Tēma, the Veids chips, "Notīrīt visu"), the place and Veids lists, the drawer with counts and search, the group card and row, the create card, "Rādīt vēl", event rows by day a week at a time. The day strip and the calendar only after your review. Plan item 3.1.

  6. R6 · Panels

    The opened group and event panels with their own addresses, "Sazināties" and "Eju" from them, and the event cases (question 8) (D15).

  7. R7 · Search

    The plain header field that opens the search at once, the Kur button and the matching themes as chips at its top, recent searches; "Rādīt visus rezultātus" opening discovery with the search word as a chip (approved 13 Oct, AP-07). Plan item 3.5.

  8. R8 · Your own area

    Manas grupas (with question 9 answered), the Ziņas page in the frame, the Paziņojumi page, the "new" count (D4, D13, D14). Migrationadd_user_my_groups_seen_at

  9. R9 · A group's life

    The event page, the event form with its place, Biedri, Jaunumi, settings with "Ko meklējam?", Mans profils and someone else's profile. Plan items 3.3 (and 3.6 later).

  10. R10 · Citur and the unknown place

    Distances between cities, the visitor's place kept on the device (D5, D16). Migrationadd_city_coordinates

  11. R11 · Admin frame

    Sections across, pages down the left, the phone drawer; the admin pages in the new look; the category-moving page stays reached from a group's site-admin tools.

  12. R12 · Everything else

    Sign in, register, choosing a username, the create-group wizard, Par mums, Privātums, page not found, the cookie banner.
